item.title: Core Keeper Mining Guide — Wall Hardness, Drill Efficiency and the Best Digging Routes
item.description: The ore tier guide tells you which ore lives in which ring. This guide goes deeper: how mining damage actually resolves against walls, how to plan tunnels so you never waste swings, and how drills turn ore boulders into an infinite late-game ore supply. How wall damage really works A wall does not have a simple health bar. Every hit first deducts a flat resistance, and only the leftover damage bites into wall health.
